top_signals.title: Finance Ministry panel set to caution Takaichi over importance of market trust
top_signals.summary: Drawing on examples of societal unrest, the Fiscal System Council warns that Japan must be aware of risks stemming from inflation and yield spikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
